name: Dr. Heber Robarts
role: Dickinson physician; the Marquis de Morès' family and company doctor
bio: Dr. Heber Robarts was a Dickinson physician and Northern Pacific Beneficiary Association surgeon who made frequent trips to Medora. In 1885 he amputated Frank Walker's leg, operated on Mrs. Draper with Dr. McIntosh, and treated a gunshot wound and other injuries. In May 1885 the Marquis retained him as family and company physician, to spend about three days a week in Medora. By May 1886 another doctor had replaced him as railroad surgeon and he had charge of Hunter's Hot Springs, and in December 1886 the paper reported him practising in Livingston.
